name: National Finance Olympiad
long_description:
NFO is building India’s financial education platform for students.

We make financial education structured, engaging and competitive through age-appropriate curricula, AI-proctored assessments and nationally recognised certification. Our platform enables schools to introduce financial education without adding to their academic workload, while giving students a measurable way to learn, apply and demonstrate financial knowledge.

We’re building toward a future where financial education is a standard part of every Indian student’s education.
one_liner: The SAT of Financial Education in India.
